description: The Electronic Signature endpoint allows for the creation of a Electronic Signature

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: company_id (either company_id or project_id is required)

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: project_id (either project_id or company_id is required)

parameters.name: object_id
parameters.description: ID of the object for which we need the create the electronic signature

parameters.name: object_type
parameters.description: Type of the object for which we need the create the electronic signature

id.description: Unique identifier of the electronic signature. Use as the {electronic_signature_id} path parameter for the show, void, withdraw, and refresh endpoints.

object_id.description: Identifier of the source record (for example, a contract or requisition) the electronic signature was created for. Paired with object_type to locate the signed item.

object_type.description: Class name of the source record the electronic signature was created for.

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the electronic signature (for example, created, signed, or voided).

created_at.description: Timestamp when this electronic signature record was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this electronic signature record was last updated

metadata.description: Display metadata describing the current state of the electronic signature.

title.description: Human-readable title summarizing the current state of the electronic signature.

message.description: Human-readable message providing additional detail about the current state of the electronic signature.

type.description: Category of the metadata, used to style or group the status message in the UI.

actions.description: Actions that can be performed on the electronic signature in its current state.

name.description: Identifier of an action that can currently be performed on the electronic signature.

url.description: URL used to invoke this action.

display_name.description: Localized, human-readable label for the action, suitable for display on a button.

ball_in_court_names.description: Names of the users currently responsible for acting on the electronic signature (ball-in-court).

items.description: Name of a user currently responsible for acting on the electronic signature.

account_type.description: Provider type. Pass "manual" to create a manual upload electronic signature record without requiring DocuSign or ProcoreSign. Omit for standard DocuSign / ProcoreSign flows.

prostore_file_id.description: ID of the pre-uploaded signed document. Required when account_type is "manual".

redirect_path.description: Relative path (no host or scheme) to redirect the user to. Absolute or protocol-relative paths are rejected.
